compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
The LLM gates carry leftovers from finished cutovers and one retired demo: the single-pass review-a-ticket engine (a demo the project has been retiring; the real reviews are the four-phase plan review and four-phase code review, whose single-turn criteria are steps inside those workflows), two shadow comparators, a spot-eval harness with an unreachable entry point, private re-exports that ADR 0111 forbids, severity residue from ADR 0108, a finished A/B env var, a legacy overlay routing form that clients may still use, and five attestation helpers independently confirmed dead on origin/main. Each is small; together they are the kind of retained rollback twin the operator named as the target class on 2026-09-06.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The single-pass demo is fully retired: its engine, parity harness, prompt, eval spec, and eval-solver branch are gone, the catalog has exactly one default reviewer (`code-quality`), and the four-phase plan-review and code-review workflows are byte-unchanged. Checked by the demo story's greps and the regenerate-index drift gate.
- [ ] No finished-cutover scaffolding remains: the shadow comparators, the spot-eval harness, and the private re-exports are deleted with their only importers migrated. Checked by the scaffolding story's greps.
- [ ] Severity no longer drives any gate policy, `REBAR_VERIFY_PREFETCH` is gone with prefetch always on, and the legacy overlay `activate:` list form warns once per overlay through the deprecation registry while still working. Checked by the priority-driven step tests, the prefetch spy test, and the two overlay warning tests.
- [ ] The five dead attestation helpers are removed, the duplicated unresolvable-ref message is single-sourced, and the plan-review status surface emits only values its schema declares. Checked by the attestation story's greps and the parametrized status test.
- [ ] Every client-facing change carries a release-notes line. Checked by the entries each story adds.

## Child decomposition
- Cutover scaffolding story: delivers criterion 2.
- Demo retirement story: delivers criterion 1, depends on the scaffolding story (shared test file and a relocated-prompts tuple).
- Severity and prefetch story: delivers the severity and prefetch half of criterion 3.
- Overlay warning story: delivers the overlay half of criterion 3, depends on the demo story for a registry note.
- Attestation helpers story: delivers criterion 4.
- Criterion 5 is delivered by each story's own release-notes line.
compiled_state.title: LLM gates: retire the single-pass demo, finished-cutover leftovers, severity residue, and confirmed-dead attestation helpers
